zweig_breadth_thrust_status.method: Algorithmic fallback own-version Zweig Breadth Thrust over 10D EMA of S&P 500 constituent advancing/(advancing+declining); current S&P 500 constituent history is survivorship-biased; setup window refreshes on every new <= lower reading

ma_breadth_compression_status.method: Current S&P 500 constituents; survivorship-biased breadth history

binary_accumulation_status.method: SPY combined ROC windows in binary form

btc_binary_xl_status.method: BTC-USD combined ROC windows in binary XL form

gold_binary_status.method: Gold combined ROC windows in binary form

rsp_spy_breadth_status.signal_method: strict regime starts: score extreme, 3M relative move and 252D z-score aligned for 10 trading days, 252-day cooldown

pe_ratio_status.source: Multpl monthly S&P 500 trailing P/E (last available: 2026-09-01)

new_lows_52w_status.method: 10D SMA of percent of current S&P 500 constituents at 12-month closing lows; survivorship-biased

new_highs_52w_status.method: 10D SMA of percent of current S&P 500 constituents at 12-month closing highs; survivorship-biased

ptf_style_model.method: Daily 3M/6M/12M excess-return ranking vs SPY (20%/30%/50%); score weighted shadow portfolio.
